cells.normalized_text: Timelost Magazine Vault of Glass Raid

Weapon Kills grant additional +1?% ↑+?% Super Ability Energy. On Super Ability End: Refills Magazine. 100% Increased Base Magazine Capacity for 20 ↑+21 seconds. Found Verdict reloads 2 shells at a time. Base Magazine Increases change the base value, meaning it stacks with Increased Magazine Capacity effects like Overflow. This also means it changes mag-based effects such as gaining Bolt Charge. Buff can be activated while stowed, and persists through stow.

Reload Perk Notes: Generate = Grants Ammo to Magazine out of thin air, up to its Base Magazine Size. Does not work with Overflown Magazines. Overflow = Increases Base Magazine Capacity by a certain amount, rounded up. Refill = Reload, but does not have an animation and doesn't proc on-reload perks. Pulls from reserves on Special and Power Weapons. For Heat Weapons, it will instead be "Dissipates X Heat" to discern it from manual venting Reload = Procs on-reload perks. Manual Reload, Marksman's Dodge, and Dragon's Shadow all count as regular reloads. For Heat Weapons, finishing a manual vent will count as a regular reload.

implementation.super_ended_contract: chorus_d2:super_ended is a trusted content lifecycle event for the owner, tagged chorus:super_ability. The test producer emits once on expiration of an actually paid synthetic super state; it never emits from cast rejection or explicit removal.
implementation.capacity: Grant weapon-scoped20/21-second resettable buff before reserve refill. External magazine_capacity profile carries base_bonus; test input5 becomes10. Expiry/detach changes derived capacity but retains existing loaded rounds.
implementation.reload: Found Verdict source tag contributes +1 shell to a one-shell baseline through existing reload_insert_rounds. Accepted insertion keeps its captured portion; next insertion observes current buff/capacity.
implementation.energy: Weapon owner and weapon_kill credit required. Each kill uses that source variant mandatory base fraction, targets the currently selected super account through grant_ability_energy and normal recipient scaling; no selection is explicit no grant.
implementation.combination: Overflow uses current derived capacity. Physical one-round ammo brick is synthetic allocation; enhanced Overflow can turn10 baseline into22 loaded rounds using own reserves.
implementation.scope: Test data and real runtime mechanics only; no production super/weapon catalogue or numerical calibration claim.
